item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-192: themes Swift and Rétro 5250
item.body:
LOT-192

Refs #733 (partial: colours and font of both themes; what is left is #1370)
Claim: mac/mac-mbp
Author model: Sonnet 5.5 (mac/mac-mbp-w733)
Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (mac/mac-mbp-r1369)

### Problem
The theme gallery (LOT-188) only had Legacy. #733 asks for « Swift » (Classiques, light/dark) and « Rétro 5250 » (Rétro, single variant, monospaced).

### Change
- `App/SwiftHFR/Themes/swift/swift.theme.json` and `Themes/retro-5250/retro-5250.theme.json`, from the operator's token draft (`docs/assets/themes/tokens/themes.json`, validated 2026-11-10). Colours and font only; `decorations` null.
- Draft values that failed THEMES.md §3 were changed to the closest passing value (same hue, a small margin, >= 4.6:1 where the pair is not tied to the draft). **Operator: please confirm these colours**:

| Token | Draft | Shipped | Worst pair (ratio) | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Swift light `textSecondary` | #696B73 | #5F616B | on `selection`, 4.91 | draft 4.24 |
| Swift light `spoilerBackground` | #DCDFEA | #E3E5EE | `link` on it, 4.74 | draft 4.48 |
| Swift dark `accentText`, `link` | #C26BF2 | #DCA9F7 | on `readerAlternate`, 4.63 (selection 6.44, quote/code 6.79, spoiler 6.23) | draft 3.76 to 2.80; `accent` (fills) stays #C26BF2 |
| Swift dark `textSecondary` | #ACADB3 | #BBBCC1 | on `readerAlternate`, 4.64 | draft 3.93 |
| Rétro `selection` | #33FF33 | #0B330B | `textPrimary` on it, 9.4; `errorText`, 5.6 | reverse video gives 1.00; see #1370 |
| Rétro `spoilerBackground`, `spoilerText` | #33FF33, #000000 | #0F4A0F, #33FF33 | `link` on it, 6.37 | draft `link` on it 1.21 |

- THEMES.md §2 notes and CREDITS.md (Themes) updated.
- LOT-193 must update the exact family-list assertions when it adds OG Web: `ThemeDefinitionTests.swift` and `ThemeEngineTests.swift` (`galleryFamilies.map(\.family) == ["Classiques", "Rétro"]`).

### Not built, tracked in #1370
Swift card radius, halos, gradient, shadow; Rétro square corners, dashed separators, uppercase headers, blinking cursor (Reduce Motion), the reverse-video question; AX5 and reader `[code]` checks; forum list and topic page screenshots (no logged-in session here); operator confirmation of the colours above.

### Tests
- Red first: `swiftAndRetro5250AreBundledWithTheirFamilyVariantsAndFont` (HFRKit) failed with both files missing; `everyBundledThemeDecodesAndMeetsEveryRule` failed on the draft values and passes now.
- `swift test --filter ThemeDefinitionTests`: 14 pass (after round 1 too).
- Simulator (iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27.2), run again after round 1: ThemeEngineTests (new `swiftAndRetro5250AreInTheBundledGallery`, `theMPTitleTonesHoldInEveryBundledTheme`), ThemeAppearanceTests, ListLookSelectionTests, AccessibleColorsTests: TEST SUCCEEDED.
- Screenshots of the themes on the HFR+ import screen (no account): scratch only, not committed.
- SwiftLint by hand: line length <= 140 on added lines, no new types over limits. pre-commit passes.

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, mac/mac-mbp-r1369, head 29659e30)**: REQUEST CHANGES

Agent: mac/mac-mbp-r1369 (Opus 5.5). Author: Sonnet 5.5 (mac/mac-mbp-w733).

1. **High** (PR body, `Closes #733`): merging closes #733, but part of its scope and its acceptance criteria are not done, and no issue tracks them. Scope not built: Swift radius, halos, gradient and shadow; Rétro reverse video (the selection is dark green instead), square corners and blinking cursor (Reduce Motion). Criteria not met: the AX5 check and `[code]` vs body text in the reader, and the screenshots of the forum list and a topic page "in the PR" (the PR says they stay local, import screen only). Only `docs/THEMES.md` §2 records what is missing, so the closure drops it. Fix: either `Refs #733`, listing what is left, or open one follow-up issue (engine tokens for radius, halos, gradient, shadow, corners, dashed separators, uppercase headers, cursor; plus the AX5 and reader checks) and link it from the PR and from THEMES.md §2.
2. **Medium** (PR body `### Ledger`): the required **Docs consistency** check fails: `the Ledger section has no block (no entry: no section)`. AGENTS §8 says no entry means no section. Fix: delete the section. The check runs on a push, not on a body edit, so re-run it.
3. **Low** (`swift.theme.json:39,43`): dark `accentText`/`link` `#C26BF2` → `#E6B8FB` (a pale lilac) is forced by §3 (the draft fails on `selection` 3.89, quote/code 4.10, spoiler 3.76, `readerAlternate` 2.80). But it goes further than needed: the lightest passing colour with the same hue is about `#DAA6F7` (4.51). The tint now differs visibly from `accent` `#C26BF2` (toggles, capsule), and #733 says Swift's values are "to be confirmed with the operator". Fix: flag this colour on the PR for the operator to confirm, or use a value closer to the hue with a stated margin. The same goes for dark `textSecondary` `#C8C9CE` (lightest passing: about `#B9BABF`). The PR calls these changes "minimal", which is not accurate.
4. **Detail** (`ThemeDefinitionTests.swift:93`, `ThemeEngineTests.swift:108`): the exact check `== ["Classiques", "Rétro"]` fails as soon as LOT-193 adds OG Web. That is acceptable, but the LOT-193 author must know to update it.

Checked against the contract: every other change from the draft is forced by §3. The Rétro selection fails at 1:1 with reverse video, and the spoiler pair at 1.95 with the draft. CREDITS and THEMES name no forum pseudo.

**Verified**: `swift test --filter ThemeDefinitionTests` (14 pass). Red probes: with the Rétro folder removed, the new HFRKit test fails; with the draft dark accent put back, `everyBundledThemeDecodesAndMeetsEveryRule` fails on the 8 pairs above. I computed every contrast pair myself (Python, WCAG 2.x, including `readerAlternate`). Draft compared with the shipped files token by token. CI: SwiftLint and pre-commit pass, Docs consistency fails, macOS jobs gated (draft). App tests not run here.

2. Fixed: the `### Ledger` section is deleted from the body; the check reruns on this push.
3. Fixed: dark `accentText`/`link` #DCA9F7 (4.63 worst), dark `textSecondary` #BBBCC1 (4.64); every pair recomputed, suites rerun green. The PR body has a draft -> shipped table flagged for the operator; "minimal" is gone.
4. Noted in the PR body and THEMES.md §2: LOT-193 must update the exact family-list assertions.

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, mac/mac-mbp-r1369, head c9e25b72)**: APPROVE

Agent: mac/mac-mbp-r1369 (Opus 5.5). Author: Sonnet 5.5 (mac/mac-mbp-w733). Round 2.

Round-1 findings:
1. **High, resolved.** The PR now says `Refs #733 (partial …)`. #1370 covers everything left: Swift radius, halos, gradient and shadow; Rétro square corners, dashed separators, uppercase headers and Reduce-Motion cursor; the reverse-video question; the AX5 and reader `[code]` checks; the screenshots; the operator's confirmation of the colours. THEMES.md §2 links #1370.
2. **Medium, resolved in the body; the check still has to be re-run.** The `### Ledger` section is gone. Docs consistency failed on c9e25b72 only because its run started at 08:28:24 and read the old body, which was edited at 08:28:38. That check does not re-run on a body edit, so re-run it before merging.
3. **Low, resolved.** Dark `accentText`/`link` `#DCA9F7`: 7.71 on surface, 6.44 on selection, 6.79 on quote/code, 6.23 on spoiler, 4.63 on `readerAlternate` (`#484A56`), 8.64 on background, 8.96 on systemCard. Dark `textSecondary` `#BBBCC1`: 7.72 / 6.45 / 6.80 / 6.24 / 4.64 / 8.65. Every pair is at least 4.5, and both colours stay close to the draft hue. The PR table puts the colours to the operator.
4. **Detail, resolved.** The PR body and THEMES.md §2 tell LOT-193 to update the family-list assertions.

New:
5. **Detail** (#1370): the issue is labelled `status: ready` but contains an operator decision (reverse video versus §3). Split that item off or note it as `needs-decision`, so nobody codes it before the decision. This does not block the PR.
